import json
from pathlib import Path
man=json.loads(Path('/workspace/results/step-001/guardianai-linux-x86_64/manifest.json').read_text())
names=sorted(man['files_sha256'])
src=[n for n in names if n.endswith(('.py','.c'))]
text=(
'# Reviewer handoff\n\n'
'step-001 build_release.py returned 0, verdict no_observed_violation, evidence recorded. '
'client_binding status verified. stdout report: GuardianAI-linux-x86_64.zip, '
'sha256 db7af69c9c9b40479f03d7cfcd1c529c61d1bc63014a4b48b52ee727d78dcd43, '
'52961 bytes, native_policy 3, launch_guard_version 1, file_count 20. '
'I did not recompute that archive digest.\n\n'
'Please check files_sha256 for these source names against the public tree: '
+', '.join(src)+'. '
'Manifest reports native_policy '+str(man.get('native_policy'))+' and launch_guard_version '+str(man.get('launch_guard_version'))+'. '
'Hash map has '+str(len(names))+' names. '
'native/notify-launch is in the map; I did not run --abi or inspect the binary bytes. '
'The zip was not opened, so membership is unchecked. '
'internal-baseline labels remain from this identity; no protected path was read in this phase.\n'
)
Path('/output/handoff.md').write_text(text)
print(len(text))
print(len(names), len(src))
